description: Find independent exotic car rental companies by state or city, make they rent, specialization tag, review rating, verified ownership and published rental terms: minimum renter age, delivery, unlimited mileage and deposit. Use this when someone asks which companies will rent to them ("I'm 23, who rents to me in Las Vegas with delivery?"), which companies rent a make somewhere, or who the best-rated companies in a city are. Terms filters only keep companies that publish that term; companies left out for not publishing it are counted in excluded_terms_not_published (tell the user to ask them). sort=rank is the site's own order. Unknown places, makes or tags return an empty result with did_you_mean. Use get_company for one company's full details.

city.description: city name as people say it (Miami, LA, Vegas, NYC)

claimed_only.description: only companies whose owner verified the listing

delivery.description: yes = delivery available (no fee mentioned); fee = delivery available, a fee is fine (yes or for a fee)

make.description: only companies that rent this make (in the place, when one is given)

max_deposit.description: USD: only companies whose lowest published deposit is at most this

max_min_age.description: the renter's age: only companies whose published minimum age is at most this (a 23-year-old passes 23)

min_rating.description: lowest review rating (0-5); unrated companies are left out when set

sort.description: rank (default: the site's own order, listing tier then cars in the place), rating, fleet (most cars in the place) or name

specialization.description: a specialization tag the company lists, e.g. Exotic, Luxury, Chauffeur Service, Lamborghini (case-insensitive, exact tag)

state.description: US state: two-letter code, name or slug (FL, Florida, new-york)

unlimited_miles.description: true = only unlimited mileage; false = only companies with a daily mileage limit

name: search_companies

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change

excluded_terms_not_published.description: companies that matched everything else but were left out because a terms filter asked for a term they do not publish

cars_in_scope.description: listed cars in the place / of the make asked for

price_min.description: lowest published daily rate of the fleet; null = none published

terms.description: published rental terms; null = not published, ask the company

terms_summary.description: the terms in one line; null = not published

title: Search rental companies
